comment: A program of study offered at a campus (e.g. a degree or certificate track).

columns.name: campus_id
columns.comment: Campus this study program is offered at.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the study program, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Human-readable program code, unique within its campus (the same code may be reused at a different campus).

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Display name of the study program.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Optional free-text description of the study program.
